messages:
jess: Hey team — customer reporting lots of 401s + intermittent high tail latency after we started a canary yesterday. Customer says it started ~08:20 UTC. Can we collect repro steps and reqids? They say "auth failed" in some responses and saw spikes to 2.3s p95.

alex: Thanks — can you paste a few request IDs and an example response body if possible? Also confirm customer account_id and whether they pinned a model/version.

jess: Provided 3 reqids from their logs: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e, req_0a1b2c3f. Example response body (redacted):
```
{
  "error": "authentication failed",
  "code": 401,
  "message": "KMS key error while validating token"
}
```
Account: acct_6677, they said they pinned model "redwood-model-3@canary-2026-03" using the pin API.

sam: Quick checklist: 1) capture full debug bundle for at least one reqid 2) curl repro (with their token) 3) confirm routing (canary -> fallback) 4) billing headers if they see invoice errors. I can grab traces if you want.

alex: Tossing a minimal curl repro they can run (replace TOKEN + REQID):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-model-3@canary-2026-03","input":"Hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
Add `-v` to capture headers. Request captures will show x-rl-cost, x-rl-latency-ms, x-rl-backend.

maria: obs-bot, can you attach traces for those reqids? Also Tina, any billing flags from acct_6677?

obs-bot: Traces attached: https://observability.internal/trace/req_0a1b2c3d (p95 spike at 08:21:14, backend backend-7 returned 502 briefly), https://observability.internal/trace/req_0a1b2c3e (auth failure path, 401 at token validation).

eng-oncall: From infra side — we saw a transient KMS failure in region us-west-2 around 08:20-08:25 which produced token validation errors for a subset of requests. That explains 401s. The latency spike aligns with autoscaler reaction when a bunch of canary pods fell back to a quantized variant and warmed KV cache.

jess: Good to know. How should we collect the debug bundle for the customer so we can attach logs + traces?

sam: Ask them to run the debug bundle endpoint for a single reqid (server will zip logs + traces). Example (they need to use their token):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/internal/debug/bundle?req_id=req_0a1b2c3d" -o debug_acct6677_req0a1b2c3d.zip
```
Also capture the response headers from the original failing request (x-rl-backend, x-rl-model, x-rl-route, x-rl-cost).

tina (billing): If they mention invoice/billing errors please forward the x-account and x-invoice-id headers from the responses. We had a rate-limit billing job run at 08:18 that can cause temporary denylist enforcement, but that would be 403 not 401. Still check.

maria: Also confirm the pinning API payload they used — if they pinned a canary we may have an explicit fallback policy that triggers quantized variants when kernels missing. Ask them to share the exact JSON they used to pin (mask secrets).

jess: I'll send repro instructions to the customer now with curl examples + debug bundle steps. Any additional logs we should request?

eng-oncall: If you can get the backend instance ID from x-rl-backend header we can correlate to the node and check kernel availability. If fallback happened, you'll see x-rl-fallback: true and x-rl-fallback-reason: "kernel-mismatch" or "capacity".

alex: After they send debug bundle, I'll run local curl repro with a short stub token and reproduce the headers. If it's KMS, SRE will coordinate with infra to restore full KMS availability and re-ingest any failed token exchanges.

jess: Thanks — I'll update when customer uploads bundle. Adding quick note to customer message: include (1) three failing request IDs, (2) curl -v output and headers, (3) debug bundle zip, (4) pinning JSON. Keep any PII out. :thumbsup:

maria: FYI deploy-bot shows the canary metadata: model=redwood-model-3@canary-2026-03, rollout: 10% -> pinned for acct_6677 via admin-pin at 07:58 UTC. Fallback mapping: redwood-model-3@canary-2026-03 -> quantized variant redwood-model-3@q-2026-02 when kernels unavailable.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout record: acct_6677 pinned -> 10% global canary; admin-pin delta recorded (actor: ops-console).

jess: All right closing loop after bundle. If we see fallback flag we'll check fallback logs and communicate to customer. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
